title: TOXIFRENCH: Benchmarking and Enhancing Language Models via CoT Fine-Tuning for French Toxicity Detection

bias_targets.methodology: Benchmarking over 20 LLMs, SLMs, and moderation APIs on a native, culturally-grounded French toxicity dataset (TOXIFRENCH) to assess their ability to detect language-specific nuances, slang, and implicit toxicity compared to their performance on English-centric or translated data.

Analyzing the disparity between precision and recall across toxic and non-toxic classes to evaluate the models' tendency to systematically overestimate toxicity (high precision on non-toxic content but low recall).
